note: Additional product photos (scripts). Photos edited in the CMS live in each model file (field "photo"); these entries are merged in, the model file wins. Product photos for the repair finder, one entry per catalogue model (field model = brand/catalogue ID). Only clean product photography (device isolated on a white, light or transparent background, whole device, no hands, people or surroundings) with a licence that allows commercial use on this website: purchased stock (e.g. iStock/Depositphotos with a standard licence, not 'editorial use only'), manufacturer images with written permission, or free licences (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Images are normalised with scripts/photos/normalize.py. A model without an entry shows the drawing; it is listed as missing in project-audit/MODEL-PHOTOS.md. Never map an image of another model.
